output.reason: The migration guide [ev-bea0311eb482] gives the subject (the IPWhiteList middleware) and the change (renamed to IPAllowList, with the same configuration). It does not say what happens if an operator does nothing: the old IPWhiteList name could still be accepted as a deprecated alias, ignored, or rejected. The CRD schema check also shows that spec.ipWhiteList is still in the traefik.io Middleware schema in v3.0.0 [ev-0842f8f3bd9d], which refutes a plain field rename or removal. So the consequence, and therefore who is actually exposed, cannot be decided without upstream text (such as the linked PR or the middleware docs) that says whether the old name still works in v3.
